what_changed: Tile sector performance is outperforming peer industries, driven by recent price hikes and strong domestic housing demand.

Account-level utility bill payments and fuel-mix flexibility to gauge operational disruption.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces rising payment defaults, broker frauds, and lab-grown diamond cost pressures.
what_changed: Textile traders and diamond polishers are reporting elevated payment frauds and multi-crore default risks.
Lab-grown diamond polishers face a 10% input cost hike due to Chinese measures on rough diamonds.
Textile industry associations are pushing for regulatory shifts and a machinery duty exemption extension until 2032 to avoid a 9.74% tax burden.
Madhya Pradesh plans a diamond processing hub following the Surat model, potentially threatening long-term processing dominance.
stress_signals: Lab-grown rough diamond prices increased by 10% following Chinese measures, impacting production costs [9cbc45a9c3f9]
SGCCI demanded BNS amendments to combat rising payment defaults and financial fraud in Surat's textile market [c3927b4b71cd]
A Katargam diamond trader was defrauded of 1,035 carats of polished diamonds worth Rs 1.27 crore by a broker [e8488d4182be]

improvement_signals: Garden Silk Mills and MANTRA completed joint research trials to develop a new polymeric yarn [a09df64b91a6]
